rows.jyutping: gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6 ge3 jan4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a person whose claimed morals or beliefs do not match their actions.

example.english: They always scold people for not being eco-friendly, but they litter themselves—they’re such a hypocrite.
example.traditional: 佢成日鬧人唔環保，自己就亂掉垃圾，真係假仁假義嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 naau6 jan2 m4 waan4 bou2 zi6 gei2 zau6 lyun6 diu6 laap6 saap3 zan1 hai6 gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone pretends to be morally upright or principled.

example.english: They keep claiming to be the most moral person, but secretly cheat old people—they’re a real hypocrite.
example.traditional: 佢口口聲聲話自己最有道德，背後卻專呃老人家，真係偽君子。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hau2 hau2 seng1 seng1 waa6 zi6 gei2 zeoi3 jau5 dou6 dak1 bui3 hau6 koek3 zyun1 ngaak1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 ngai6 gwan1 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a hypocrite specifically when the person presents different faces or positions to different people.

example.english: They act one way with the boss and another with their colleagues—they’re a real hypocrite.
example.traditional: 佢對住老闆一套，對住同事又一套，真係兩面派。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 lou5 baan2 jat1 tou3 deoi3 zyu6 tung4 si6 jau6 jat1 tou3 zan1 hai6 loeng5 min6 paai3
